description: 49-level hybrid sigma-pressure coordinate of the FV3 dynamical core (Lagrangian vertical coordinate with remapping to the reference hybrid levels). The model top is at 1 Pa (0.01 hPa, about 79 km). Levels are pure pressure levels above about 208 hPa (28 layers) and terrain-following hybrid levels below. The lowest layer is about 35 m thick (lowest full level at about 17 m above the surface), with 10 layers below 850 hPa and 24 layers above 100 hPa. Layer thicknesses in metres are approximate, computed for a surface pressure of 1013.25 hPa and the 1976 US Standard Atmosphere.
